name: Rime Seer
definitionRules: Summon a 13 HP / 5 Power Thrall. Attacks apply 3 Chill.
rules: Summon Rime Seer: 13 HP / 5 Power. Attacks apply 3 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
displayRules:
